purpose: Measure the complete candidate change on common, unsupported, eligible-nonzero and newly provable scalar queries, separately from full native hull costs.
prerequisites: Unchanged finite-image broad qualification: eleven commands and assessor complete.
Deterministic-selection broad qualification: ten commands complete.
Closed deterministic-selection native timing trial: fifty-eight commands and assessor complete, with slowdowns retained.
New deterministic-selection native resource trial: thirty-four commands and assessor complete, all group/phase references validated.
source_change: None. Reuse the frozen v1 Rust probe unchanged and link the same baseline, late and finite-image hyperreal libraries. Verify every mapped hyperreal file in the deterministic-hull source is identical to its finite-image parent; the mesh selection change does not add a fourth scalar implementation.
phases: One first explicit query, then a fixed number of queries on the same prepared retained value. Constructors and shared constants may already have warmed caches; first query is not claimed to mean a wholly cold internal state.
modes: requested global allocator traffic and retained/peak byte deltas
mathematical_controls: Exact rational 1/3 and positive unit-tetrahedron orientation must remain certified. Pythagorean/double-angle zero identities must be certified by both cyclotomic candidates. The original 32x16 zero quadruple [0,1,368,256] must be certified by the early image candidate. Every definite fact is checked against its exact rational or sign oracle; replay may strengthen an Unknown and may never weaken a known fact. Unsupported and eligible nonzero queries must not manufacture a rational or zero certificate.
input_identity: Fixed Rust construction recipes; no float projection. Coarse structural kind metadata is emitted after query measurements and compared across groups; it is explicitly not claimed to be a dispatch trace.
timing_scope: Query-body wall time includes black-box barriers, exact-result assertions and monotonicity checks. First-query singleton timers and allocator-instrumented timers do not support performance claims.
screen_rule: Only repeated-query phases with equal per-iteration certification counts are eligible. Flag image/reference overhead when all six paired ratios exceed 1.10, the median exceeds 1.15, and both median phase times are at least 2000000 ns. Otherwise inconclusive. Different certification capability is reported separately, not treated as an optimization comparison.
retention_scope: Requested heap allocator traffic and live-byte deltas; not stack usage, usable allocator sizes, RSS or a universal memory bound.
frozen_sample_policy: No extension, filtering, replacement or pooling with other experiments. Preserve the original first failure if one occurs.
pending_after_trial: final public resource documentation and admission record
version_reason: The old native resource trial failed on previously unknown warm triangulation variation. It remains closed and unchanged. The original scalar v1 protocol stays unexecuted because its prerequisite was never satisfied. This v2 protocol uses the completed, separately frozen resource comparison with independently validated group/phase references. No old measurement samples are reused or pooled.
affine_original_zero_recipe: The scalar cost recipe uses original 32x16 source indices [0,1,368,256] at unit radius. It is a finite scalar API cost case, not a replacement for any full-resolution native sphere input or a native hull performance gate.
